en-US.author: TAPATCH
en-US.description: Real-time clicks-per-second (CPS) counter that catches every click from a low-level mouse hook.
en-US.license: Free for personal use; commercial use requires a paid license
en-US.longDescription:
ClickMeter tracks your click rate in real time with no overhead. It counts every click straight from a low-level mouse hook, so nothing slips past — even rapid or injected bursts that browser-based testers miss. Track left, right, or middle clicks, alone or combined. Live CPS updates instantly, peak and session average stay visible, and a configurable history chart shows anywhere from the last 30 seconds up to your full session. Tiny binary, zero telemetry, entirely local.

Free for personal use; business or commercial use requires a paid license.
en-US.name: ClickMeter
en-US.releaseNotes:
- Now opens in virtual machines, Remote Desktop and on PCs without a graphics driver: it switches to Direct3D 12 when OpenGL doesn't work
- If the window still can't open, a message says why instead of the app closing without a word
